notes:
PD: Auric builds AI-driven contact center automation for B2B customers (ticket routing, assisted agent UI, SLA-driven escalation). Currently evaluating Redwood for RAG-enabled agent assist and scalable tool-calling. Key asks: high-quality source-level citations, freshness guarantees for KB updates, multi-source retrieval (Zendesk/Confluence/Drive/DB), deterministic reranking, and predictable behavior during support spikes.

POC summary: ran a 2-week workload test w/ simulated peak of 5k concurrent agents (synthetic). Focus areas: retrieval latency under burst, end-to-end agent assist latency, ticket summarization quality, integration with internal ticketing APIs for tool-calls (open/escalate/annotate). Observed: retrieval hit-rate ~72% on first-pass vector search; some stale docs surfaced for policies older than 90d. Caching reduced token cost by ~18% but introduced staleness edge cases.

Security/compliance notes: requires SSO (SAML), tenant-level audit logs, KMS integration for key management, and data residency for EU customers. Legal wants a DPA and clarity on ephemeral cache retention TTL.

Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "We need search that cites the exact KB passage and timestamp — agents must be able to click the source, not just get a hallucinated line. Freshness >90% for policy docs."

Integration/UX asks: single-pane agent UI with: source citations, quick-tool buttons (create ticket, escalate to tier-2, send templated reply), and confidence signals. Tool-calling must be idempotent and observable in logs.

POC artifacts: fireflies demo, transcript + perf deck (drive links above). Jira tickets created for: connector reliability (CSUP-1287) and doc-staleness incidents (CSUP-1294).

use_case_summary: Primary: real-time agent assist that surfaces short, cited KB snippets; secondary: automatic ticket summarization for case handoffs and analytics. Must support tool-calls to ticketing system (create/update/escalate) with strict idempotency and clear audit trail. RAG pipeline must merge signals from vector DB and keyword-indexed sources and prefer fresh authoritative policy docs.
latency_targets: p95_generation < 350ms for template replies; retrieval roundtrip < 80ms for vector + filter; end-to-end agent assist < 700ms under normal load; during spikes acceptable SLO degradation to p95 < 1200ms
technical_requirements: Hybrid retrieval: vector search + inverted-index filters, metadata-level routing (product, region, doc-type), per-source TTL and automated reindex on doc change events. Per-request citation metadata (doc id, chunk_offset, last_updated). Reranker model for top-10 candidates. Fallback path: smaller local model for degraded capacity; circuit-breaker + graceful failure mode. Must support connectors to Zendesk, Confluence, Drive, internal SQL listings. Metrics: per-query cost, tokens saved via prefix caching, citation precision & freshness percentage.
